featured_reviews.name: Nita Kini
featured_reviews.review_text:
Woke up craving for idli and dosa and we've practically eaten from every south indian restaurant in Goregaon so wanted to try a place that claimed it gave a home style experience. Since we're south indians too, we expected it to taste exactly how they promised it to. The super soft idli and the set dosai immediately transported us to Mangalore. Absolutely loved the fact that it's not trying to please anybody and give people an authentic experience. The sambar and chutney were exactly what is made at home.

The packaging was refreshingly good. The dosa came in a pizza type box which kept the shape intact and the idlis were in a nice plate box. Loved everything about this.

The manager was sweet enough to call up and tell us the taste we'd expect from the sambar would be different from what we're used to eating but tbh, that's exactly what we wanted.

I think I've found a permanent breakfast place in Mumbai! Can't wait for them to start making vadas too. 100% recommend this place if you want a authentic experience. You'll find the mainstream kinds everywhere, this was uniquely "homely". Love it!

The highlight, of course, was the mango-infused twist to the classic sadya. From the refreshing mango pachadi to the subtly sweet notes in the curries, each bite struck a perfect balance between nostalgia and innovation. The rice paired effortlessly with the rich sambar and avial, while the crispy papadam added that much-needed crunch. And ending the meal with a luscious mango payasam was nothing short of indulgent.
The ambiance complemented the experience—simple, clean, and rooted in South Indian culture—allowing the food to truly shine. The staff was courteous and ensured everything was served fresh and on time, enhancing the overall dining experience.
If you’re looking to celebrate Vishu in an authentic yet slightly contemporary way, this mango sadya at Kamat Legacy, Malad is definitely worth experiencing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
🌿 Banana Leaf – A Slice of South India in Malad 🌿

If you’re looking for authentic South Indian vegetarian cuisine, Banana Leaf is easily one of the best in Malad. This place celebrates the flavors of the South with a menu that spans specialties from Andhra, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka — bringing the diversity of Southern kitchens onto your plate.

The variety is impressive: from crisp dosas, fluffy idlis, crunchy vadas, and hearty uttapams to full traditional meals. The highlight for me was their Dakshin Bhojanam Thali — a wholesome spread of curries paired with appam or parotta, with a choice of bisi bele bhath or steamed rice. Each bite was a journey through authentic regional flavors.

We also tried the Rasam Vada, and I must say — the rasam was outstanding. Honestly, I’d visit again just for that comforting, tangy-soulful bowl.

The ambience is cozy and minimalistic, enhanced by soft South Indian instrumental music and staff dressed in traditional attire — little touches that complete the cultural vibe. The service is warm, cordial, and attentive, making the whole experience even better.

Extremely Disappointing Experience – Food Safety Ignored & Unprofessional Behaviour
This was my first and last experience with this restaurant, and unfortunately, it has been deeply disturbing—not just because of the food issue but because of how the staff and social media team handled it.
I ordered Davanagere Benne Masala Dosa from the Malad West outlet and found hard, crystal/plastic-like foreign particles inside the food while eating. This is a serious food safety and hygiene violation, not a minor complaint.
When I contacted the restaurant, one of the staff members assured me that they would help and specifically guided me to approach Zomato and also email them, stating that this was the correct process. I followed their instructions exactly. However, Zomato outright refused to help or issue a refund, despite clear photographic evidence.
What is truly shocking is what followed next.
When I went back to the restaurant team and their social media handles for support, instead of standing by their words or taking responsibility, they completely changed their attitude.
My comments explaining the issue were deleted from their social media pages
Messages were left unanswered
There was no follow-up, no accountability, and no resolution
This behaviour feels like a deliberate attempt to silence genuine complaints rather than address a serious concern. Saying “we are here to help” and then deleting comments and ignoring the customer is highly unprofessional, unethical, and misleading.
If this is how a restaurant reacts to a food contamination issue, it raises serious questions about their internal standards and customer ethics. Customers are not asking for favours—we are asking for basic food safety and honest accountability.
I am extremely disappointed with the staff’s behaviour and the way the social media team handled this matter. This review is being posted so other customers are aware of how genuine issues are treated once money has already been taken.
Food quality, customer trust, and transparency clearly need urgent attention here.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Customer,
This matter has been reviewed and addressed multiple times by our team.
The order was placed through a third-party delivery platform (Zomato). As per mandatory platform protocol, refunds can only be processed once a formal request is raised through the same platform. We had clearly and explicitly conveyed our willingness to approve the refund immediately upon receiving the official intimation from Zomato. However, to date, no such intimation has been received by us.
As part of our standard food-safety and quality-assurance procedures, we requested verification of the alleged foreign object. This request was declined from your end, making it impossible for us to validate the claim or initiate any corrective action.
Despite repeated communication and clear guidance on the appropriate resolution process, the matter has instead been escalated publicly across social media and review platforms. Such actions do not enable a fair, factual, or verifiable resolution.
We reiterate that we remain open to resolving this matter strictly through the appropriate and verifiable channel. Any further public allegations made without substantiation or cooperation will be duly noted.
We remain fully committed to hygiene, quality, and fair resolution for all our customers—something that is consistently reflected in our long-standing reputation and customer feedback to date.

Team,
Shree Gomateshwara Bhavan
